text: Four. Did you see in the paper that Sven Lastrum passed away? His funeral is next Saturday. No, I didn't. Who is he? I don't think I've heard of him. Sven Lastrum? He was a really great Swedish director. He made some of my favourite films. Haven't you ever seen Oranges in August? No, never. Or Anna and Maya and Jens? No, sorry. So how did he die?
